title: CRS-aware area + great-circle distance
query: What is the area of Champaign County, Illinois, in square kilometres? And what is the great-circle distance in km between Trafalgar Square, London (51.5080 N, 0.1281 W) and Notre-Dame de Paris (48.8530 N, 2.3499 E)?

expected_why.distance_km: pyproj Geod(WGS84).inv; a spherical haversine is within 0.3%

answer:
**Area of Champaign County, Illinois**

The area of Champaign County, Illinois, is approximately **2,584.6 km²** (2,584.62 km²). This was computed from the US Census TIGERweb boundary polygon (GEOID 17019), reprojected to UTM zone 16N (EPSG:26916) before calculating the area to ensure accuracy.

**Great-circle distance between Trafalgar Square and Notre-Dame de Paris**

The great-circle distance between Trafalgar Square, London (51.5080° N, 0.1281° W) and Notre-Dame de Paris (48.8530° N, 2.3499° E) is approximately **343.9 km** (343.89 km). This was calculated using the Haversine formula with an Earth radius of 6,371 km.

Both values were computed and verified cleanly in the analysis.
